decisions.reason: The carpentry workshop is still an option with moderate operating costs and uncertain custom-furniture demand, so it remains worth keeping while the firm observes whether orders become steadier.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the established care business and likely inexpensive to run, so the firm keeps this low-cost option to learn about demand.
The senior-living counseling service has high strategic fit and home-page visibility, making its option value high and the probability of dropping very low.
The sheltered-workshop retail shop is more peripheral and has moderate running costs, but it is kept as a mission-aligned option while uncertainty about customer demand remains.
Meal delivery for seniors is close to the core but still an unproven logistics-heavy option, so the firm keeps it to test demand while monitoring costs.
